QrHistoryItem.title: QrHistoryItem
QrHistoryItem.description: A QR Code record saved in a user's personal QR Library. Stores text/URL content and metadata without storing Base64 image data.

content.description: The raw URL or text encoded in the QR Code.

title.description: Human-readable title derived from the QR content.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the QR Code was generated and saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the QR Code record was last updated.

/users/{uid}/qr_history/{qrId}.description: Private per-user QR Code history collection owned exclusively by the authenticated user matching uid.
